Trigger: Backspace keypress in active prompt editor
Precondition: Prompt buffer contains text with cursor > 0
Reference behavior: Deletes the preceding UTF-8 grapheme cluster and decrements cursor byte offset
Reference visual result: Character immediately to the left of cursor disappears, cursor moves left
Reference state transition: PromptState.buffer updated without deleted grapheme, cursor updated
Reference failure behavior: No-op when cursor is at index 0
Notes: Handles multi-byte CJK and combining characters

Trigger: Home / End or Ctrl+A / Ctrl+E keypress
Reference behavior: Moves cursor to byte 0 on Home/Ctrl+A and byte length on End/Ctrl+E
Reference visual result: Terminal cursor relocates to start or end of current input line

Reference behavior: Inserts full multiline string as atomic buffer insertion without auto-submitting
Reference visual result: Multiline text appears in prompt, prompt box expands to accommodate
Reference state transition: PromptState.buffer receives entire pasted text at current cursor
Reference failure behavior: Sanitizes raw escape sequences before insertion

Feature: History JSONL persistence and corruption recovery
Precondition: History file exists on disk with mixed valid/invalid JSONL lines
Reference behavior: Parses valid entries, skips malformed lines, caps at MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES (50)
Reference visual result: Up/Down arrows traverse valid historical prompts
Reference API/side effect: Reads history file from state directory
Reference failure behavior: Returns empty list if file missing or unreadable

Trigger: User submits prompt identical to the previous entry
Precondition: History has at least one entry
Reference behavior: Skips appending to history if text, mode, and parts match previous entry
Reference visual result: No duplicate history entries appear on arrow-up traversal
Reference failure behavior: Preserves entry if parts or mode differ

Trigger: User invokes message or code copy action
Precondition: Host environment has clipboard utility (wl-copy, xclip, osascript, powershell)
Reference behavior: Selects appropriate CLI provider based on OS and Wayland/X11 environment
Reference API/side effect: Executes host clipboard command via child process
Reference failure behavior: Returns None and displays error toast if no provider available
Notes: Verified on macOS, Linux, and Windows

Trigger: User finishes editing prompt in external $EDITOR and saves
Reference behavior: Strips single trailing newline for one-line prompt, preserves multiline ending
Reference visual result: Normalized text populates prompt input buffer without unwanted empty line
Reference failure behavior: Leaves buffer unchanged on non-zero exit

Reference visual result: Colors updated across all widgets according to theme definition
Reference state transition: Theme struct constructed with RGB colors
Reference failure behavior: Falls back to default opencode palette on unknown theme

Reference behavior: Converts hex string to RGB Color(r, g, b)
Reference visual result: Accurate 24-bit color rendering in truecolor terminals
Reference failure behavior: Returns None for invalid hex strings

Feature: Leader key chord window and timeout
Trigger: User presses leader key (Ctrl+X) followed by action key
Reference behavior: Enters chord state, waits up to 2000ms for next key, resolves action or resets
Reference visual result: Status bar indicates active chord pending
Reference state transition: Keymap transitions from Idle -> PendingChord -> Dispatched/Timeout
Reference failure behavior: Resets chord state without action on timeout
Notes: Handles default 44 bindings and custom overrides

Trigger: Displaying message age, retry countdowns, or elapsed tool time
Reference behavior: Formats seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks with exact reference thresholds
Reference failure behavior: Returns empty string for non-positive values

Feature: Long tool output collapse and preview truncation
Trigger: Rendering large stdout/stderr from bash/exec tools
Precondition: Tool output string exceeding line or character limits
Reference behavior: Caps line count, appends ellipsis, flags overflow boolean
Reference visual result: Collapsed preview card with expand indicator
Notes: Prevents terminal freeze on megabyte outputs

Reference visual result: Clean text rendered without altering host window title

Reference behavior: Strips OSC 52 sequence preventing silent host clipboard manipulation
Reference visual result: Clean text rendered, system clipboard untouched
Reference state transition: Safe string parsed into markdown spans

Reference visual result: Full screen TUI on launch, parent shell clean on exit
Reference state transition: Terminal mode transitions executed and cleaned up
